def envelope(fab, guard):
    """Minimal error allowance / elapsed age for every phase-device.

    The search runs over the phase-device graph whose edges are the local
    waiting intervals and the eligible direct message transfers.  Labels are
    compared lexicographically on (bound, age) so the tie break requested by
    MODEL.md ("among equal minima find the minimum elapsed age") is honoured.
    """
    P, N = fab.P, fab.N
    V = P * N
    bnd = [None] * V
    age = [0] * V
    pvid = [None] * V
    pkind = [None] * V
    heap = []
    for p in range(P):
        base = p * N
        for i in fab.anchor_nodes[p]:
            v = base + i
            if bnd[v] is None:
                bnd[v] = 0
                age[v] = 0
                heap.append((0, 0, v))
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    push = heapq.heappush
    pop = heapq.heappop
    edges = fab.edges
    drift_allow = fab.drift_allow
    S = fab.S
    while heap:
        b, a, v = pop(heap)
        if bnd[v] != b or age[v] != a:
            continue
        p, i = divmod(v, N)
        # local waiting interval
        nb = b + drift_allow[p][i]
        na = a + 1
        u = ((p + 1) % P) * N + i
        ob = bnd[u]
        if ob is None or nb < ob or (nb == ob and na < age[u]):
            bnd[u] = nb
            age[u] = na
            pvid[u] = v
            pkind[u] = -1
            push(heap, (nb, na, u))
        # eligible direct message transfers
        rho_p = fab.rho[p]
        if rho_p < guard:
            continue
        lst = edges[p].get(i)
        if not lst:
            continue
        limit = S - rho_p - guard
        for (dst, delta, cost, code, delay) in lst:
            if delay > limit:
                continue
            nb = b + cost
            na = a + delta
            u = ((p + delta) % P) * N + dst
            ob = bnd[u]
            if ob is None or nb < ob or (nb == ob and na < age[u]):
                bnd[u] = nb
                age[u] = na
                pvid[u] = v
                pkind[u] = code
                push(heap, (nb, na, u))
    return bnd, age, pvid, pkind
